description: This file implements TPM HMAC operations, including single-call and segmented HMAC, using the TSS2 ESYS library. It provides functions for creating HMACs with TPM keys, managing TPM sequence contexts, and handling errors. The code is part of the 'cuttlefish' namespace and interacts with TPM resource management and key building components.

methods.name: OneshotHmac
methods.description: Performs a TPM HMAC operation on data that fits in a single call.

methods.name: SegmentedHmac
methods.description: Performs a TPM HMAC operation on large data by segmenting it into multiple calls.

methods.name: TpmHmac
methods.description: Selects between single-call and segmented HMAC based on data size.

methods.name: TpmHmacWithContext
methods.description: Performs TPM HMAC with a specific context, creating a signing key if necessary.
